svg.title: Mutation edits and the reading frame: a fictional DNA comparison
svg.desc: The same internal coding-strand DNA window is partitioned from the same left edge. A substitution preserves grouping; deletion of three bases preserves downstream triplets; deletion of reference position four shifts the downstream partitions and leaves a two-base incomplete fragment. A separate DNA-segment exchange does not measure RNA or protein.
